implementation.targetScope: Synchronous SHA-256 for contest-paper version identifiers, HMAC-SHA256 for mock authentication, and UTF-8/Base64/Hex WordArray interoperability. Other algorithms, cipher modes, password derivation, streaming hash builders and the upstream inheritance framework are excluded.

changes: Native Node/Bun SHA-256 and HMAC with an independent FIPS-standard synchronous browser implementation; native UTF-8/Base64 codecs and no upstream runtime copied.
Typed-array input and bounded WordArray lengths; malformed hexadecimal/Base64 inputs reject rather than silently changing bytes.
Caller message/key words remain unmodified; standard vectors and independent native Node/Web Crypto oracles verify the byte contract.

caller.scope: examAttemptAdapters and paperReaderAttemptState synchronously hash long paper version IDs; mock authApi uses HMAC and UTF-8/Base64. No production authentication or unused encryption-suite adoption is implied.
